name: The Endless Woods
source:
Once upon a time,  there was a great big forest, so confusing and twisted that you could walk in one straight line and end up right back where you started.

When the overly adventurous Odessa wanders into this forest it is up to her older sister Theodosia to bring her back.

[From [url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/the-endless-woods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一片大森林，非常混乱和扭曲，你可以沿着一条直线行走，最后又回到起点。

当过于冒险的敖德萨误入这片森林时，她的姐姐狄奥多西娅将她带回来。

[来自[url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/the-endless-woods]itch.io[/url]]
